//test: The glob covers .tsx too: `src/**/*.test.ts` silently never ran a .test.tsx file, so a component-side test looked green by not existing (D54(i)). What a .test.tsx can do is bounded by --conditions react-server, which the suite needs (server-only, and the react-server React build): under it React has no createContext, so importing next/link or lucide-react throws at module scope and no real component module in this app can be imported. These tests assert TSX-level contracts, not rendered DOM — there is no DOM harness in this repo (D54(iii)).
